headline: Nigeria Central Bank Mandates Bank Link for Crypto P2P Transactions
summary: Nigeria's central bank announced new rules requiring every peer-to-peer crypto payment to be linked to a bank transaction to increase regulatory visibility over digital asset trading.
why: Central bank oversight of cryptocurrency transactions impacts digital asset liquidity and compliance costs for fintech operators and crypto traders in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria instituted new regulations on peer-to-peer cryptocurrency payments.
